note: Each pack is gpt-image-2 sheets of 1536x1024 (3x2 cells of 512px, cut with a 6px inset to 256px WebP in public/agents/<style>/). Sheet 0 (atlas, hearth, vital, kin, ledger, compass) took the Storybook faces as Image 1 with `first_sheet` + 'STYLE: ' + `first_sheet_styles[pack]`; Manga's sheet 0 is text-only (`manga_sheet_0`), since with the reference it came out as a Western cartoon; Villains' sheet 0 took the Heroes sheet 0 as Image 2 (`villains_sheet_0`). Every later sheet (`groups` 1-8, the last a single 1024px portrait) used a prompt like `later_sheets[pack]` (sheet 1's; the per-cell animal, emblem and role notes change per sheet): Image 1 the six Storybook faces, Image 2 the pack's sheet 0 as the style.
first_sheet: Image 1 is a 3x2 sheet of six existing agent portraits. Redraw THE SAME six characters in the SAME positions (top row left to right 1, 2, 3; bottom row left to right 4, 5, 6), each still recognisable: hair style and colour, skin tone, face shape, age, glasses, clothing colours, and the small emblem each wears (1 a compass badge, 2 a little house, 3 a heartbeat line, 4 two linked rings, 5 a coin, 6 a compass rose). Output exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, 1536x1024 total, every cell a complete 512x512 square portrait with NO gutters, NO borders, NO frames, NO labels, NO text, NO signatures. Each whole head and hair plus shoulders sits centred inside its own cell with generous top margin, bust cropped at mid chest, eyes at the same height in every cell, nothing crossing cell boundaries. Plain flat background per cell in the same hue as that cell in Image 1. Warm, calm, trustworthy, friendly expressions; these are helpful assistants in a personal organiser app.

first_sheet_styles.heroes: each character reimagined as an ORIGINAL friendly superhero (never any existing comic character, no existing logos or franchise costumes). Domino eye masks or simple cowls, capes or high collars, a bodysuit in that character's clothing colours, and their emblem enlarged as a bold chest symbol (1 compass badge, 2 house, 3 heartbeat line, 4 linked rings, 5 coin, 6 compass rose). Classic 1960s American comic book art: bold black inks, flat print colours, Ben-Day halftone dots, a radiating burst in the flat background. Heroic but kind, confident smiles.
first_sheet_styles.pixel: 16-bit era role-playing game character portrait pixel art. Visible square pixels on a coarse grid of about 64 by 64 pixels per portrait, upscaled crisp with nearest-neighbour, no anti-aliasing, no blur, limited palette of about 16 colours per portrait, dithering in the shading, a dark 1-pixel outline around the figure, flat single-colour background.
first_sheet_styles.animals: each character reimagined as a friendly anthropomorphic animal in a warm hand-painted gouache storybook style with fine dark ink outlines and subtle paper grain, wearing that character's same clothes and emblem. 1 a red fox in the navy jacket and cream turtleneck, 2 a badger in the green work shirt, 3 a brown hare in the coral zip fleece, 4 a brown bear in the mustard cardigan and plum blouse, 5 a barn owl with round glasses in the black knit sweater, 6 a silver-grey wolf in the tan coat and light blue shirt. Animal faces, not humans in costumes.
first_sheet_styles.ink: minimal hand-drawn black ink line portraits like friendly productivity-app avatars: confident uniform black strokes, simple geometric shapes, solid black fills for hair, small dot eyes or simple curved eyes, almost no shading, no colour at all on the figure, pure black ink on a warm off-white paper background in EVERY cell (ignore Image 1's background colours for this style; all six backgrounds are the same off-white #f7f5ef). Charming, simple, a little whimsical.
first_sheet_styles.clay: stop-motion claymation figures photographed in a small studio: plasticine and modelling clay with visible fingerprints and tool marks, rounded chunky proportions, glossy bead eyes, soft warm key light with gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, a smooth painted card backdrop in the cell's colour. Handmade and charming, not plastic CGI.
first_sheet_styles.fantasy: high fantasy adventuring guild portraits in rich painterly digital illustration with soft rim light. Same faces, recast as a fantasy party: 1 a wayfinder mage in a navy hooded robe with a glowing compass amulet, 2 a hearth druid in a green cloak with a small house-shaped lantern brooch, 3 a nimble monk-ranger in coral leathers with a heartbeat rune, 4 a gentle bard-cleric in a mustard cloak with two linked silver rings on a chain, 5 a scholar-alchemist with round spectacles in a dark scribe's coat with a gold coin clasp, 6 a grey-haired ranger captain in a tan leather coat with a compass-rose shoulder brooch. Fantasy flavour, but approachable, no weapons shown.
